name: How long does it take to install wainscoting in a typical room?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install wainscoting in a typical room?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of wainscoting installation depends on the size of the room, the chosen wainscoting style, and any necessary wall preparation. A standard room with a straightforward beadboard or picture frame style might take 1-3 days. More intricate designs, such as raised panel wainscoting, or projects requiring extensive wall repairs or custom cuts could extend the timeline to several days or even a week. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for wainscoting varies from 1-3 days for a standard room to a week for complex designs, depending on room size and style.
